Q1: 2-Methyl-2,4-pentanediol exhibits Tier 2 (Expanded Perspective) hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, inhalation, and dermal/eye effects. It is considered a demonstrated low/moderate hazard for environmental and oral exposures, but data are deficient (Tier 4) for endocrine disruption and general organ/systemic hazards.
Q2: This chemical is not present on any identified "Lists of Concern." However, it is included on the SCIL Green Circle list, indicating it is generally considered of low hazard.
Q3: With 7,774 literature references, 2-Methyl-2,4-pentanediol is extensively studied and is a well-defined small molecule. While it has 37 toxicity value records, indicating some toxicological assessment, the absence of IRIS or PPRTV evaluations and data deficiencies in endocrine disruption and organ/systemic hazards suggest its hazard profile is not exhaustively characterized.
